header.running_head: Some General Du'aas that Rasulullaah ﷺ Made

blocks.arabic_text: يَا وَلِيَّ الْإِسْلَامِ وَأَهْلِهٖ ثَبِّتْنِيْ بِهٖ حَتّٰى أَلْقَاكَ
blocks.text:
du'aa saying:
"O Defender of Islaam and the Muslims! Keep me steadfast on Islaam until the day I meet You"[^1]

blocks.narrator: Hadhrat Busr bin Abu Artaat Qurashi (RA)
blocks.arabic_text: اَللّٰهُمَّ أَحْسِنْ عَاقِبَتَنَا فِي الْأُمُوْرِ كُلِّهَا وَأَجِرْنَا مِنْ خِزْيِ الدُّنْيَا وَعَذَابِ الْآخِرَةِ
blocks.text:
Hadhrat Busr bin Abu Artaat Qurashi (RA) reports that he heard Rasulullaah ﷺ make the following du'aa:
"O Allaah! Conclude all our affairs in a most beautiful manner and save us from disgrace in this world as well as the punishment of the Aakhirah"[^2]
Another narration adds that Rasulullaah ﷺ said, "Whoever recites this du'aa will die before being put through tribulations."[^3]

blocks.arabic_text: اَللّٰهُمَّ إِنِّيْ أَسْأَلُكَ غِنَايَ وَغِنٰى مَوْلَايَ
blocks.text:
Hadhrat Abu Sirma (RA) narrates that Rasulullaah ﷺ used to say:
"O Allaah! I ask You to grant independence to me and to all those associated with me"[^4]

blocks.arabic_text: اَللّٰهُمَّ إِنِّيْ أَسْأَلُكَ الطَّيِّبَاتِ وَتَرْكَ الْمُنْكَرَاتِ وَحُبَّ الْمَسَاكِيْنِ وَأَنْ تَتُوْبَ عَلَيَّ وَإِنْ أَرَدْتَ بِعِبَادِكَ فِتْنَةً أَنْ تَقْبِضَنِيْ غَيْرَ مَفْتُوْنٍ
blocks.text:
Hadhrat Thowbaan (RA) narrates that Rasulullaah ﷺ used to make du'aa saying:
"O Allaah! I ask You for all that is lawful, for the resolve to stay away from evil, for the love of the poor and to accept my repentance. When You intend putting Your servants through tribulation, I ask You to take me away without undergoing any of it"[^5]

blocks.arabic_text: اَللّٰهُمَّ اجْعَلْ أَوْسَعَ رِزْقِكَ عَلَيَّ عِنْدَ كِبَرِ سِنِّيْ وَانْقِطَاعِ عُمُرِيْ
blocks.text:
Hadhrat Aa'isha (RA) narrates that one of the du'aas Rasulullaah ﷺ used to make was:
"O Allaah! Allocate the greatest quantity of the sustenance you give me to my old age and to the period just before my death"[^6]
